control_experiment.conclusion: The Baltic index is a daily broker survey whose panellists anchor on the previous print, so its returns are strongly autocorrelated (+0.62) and forecastable. BDRY is a liquid arbitraged ETF over the same underlying; its returns are near-white (+0.05) and our model has -11.2% skill on it, i.e. none. Live deployment therefore needs SAIL's own Baltic licence rather than a free proxy.
